# Numerical parity fixtures

These binary fixtures hold reference outputs of the Python model for 14
sequences (457 tokens). `inference.parity.test.ts` compares the TypeScript
inference engine with them, value by value, and checks padding neutrality.

The sequences are the shortest and the longest, plus one example of every
predicted speech-act and schedule-kind class. All five model heads are covered.
The values are exact slices of a 512-sequence Python reference run, taken at
sequence indices `0, 1, 3, 4, 10, 11, 14, 21, 24, 30, 56, 149, 250, 304`. They
were not regenerated by the TypeScript code under test.
